```c
void copy_name(const char *input) {
    char buf[16];
    strncpy(buf, input, sizeof(buf) - 1);
    buf[sizeof(buf) - 1] = '\0';
    puts(buf);
}
```

EXPLANATION: Ensured that `strncpy` does not write past the end of the buffer and manually set the last character to null to ensure null termination.

INCLUDES: <stdio.h>, <string.h>
